title: Quaintly Tangy Peruvian Sweet Potatoes Picarones
description: A traditional Peruvian dish with a tangy twist, featuring sweet potatoes and dried chillies in a crispy picarones form, served in a terracotta dish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the diced sweet potatoes, crushed dried chillies, corn flour, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the water to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each piece into a picarones form.
Heat the vegetable oil in a terracotta dish over medium heat.
Fry the picarones until they are crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Remove the picarones from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the picarones hot in the terracotta dish.
